title: Simulation of ground-water flow in southeastern Coastal Plain clastic aquifers in Georgia and adjacent parts of Alabama and South Carolina
citation: Faye, R.E., and Mayer, G.C., 1997, Simulation of ground-water flow in southeastern Coastal Plain clastic aquifers in Georgia and adjacent parts of Alabama and South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Professional Paper 1410-F, map scale 1:4,000,000.
notes: Plates only (12 OCR sheets). Plates 5-9 and 12 are simulated potentiometric surfaces and plate 11 compares simulated and observed water levels at Georgia wells: model values, not recorded. Plate 10 is Georgia ground-water use. Plates 2-3 (sections A-A', B-B') are in Alabama, Georgia and Florida. Plate 4 (section C-C', Aiken to Beaufort County, S.C.): South Carolina well labels and total depths and the tops of geohydrologic units at well SC26 read from page images of the cached PDF; elevations read off the section scale are approximate and inferred; SC16 total depth not legible; Georgia wells (G10, G29, G30) and the lower inset section not recorded. Plate 1 correlation chart OCR is badly garbled; only South Carolina formation names legible in the text recorded, with stage ages from the chart row flagged inferred. No reference list in the plates.
